jobs.title: About Us
jobs.description: About Us - CYVIATION Our Platform Compliance Intelligence About Us Company Leadership Careers News Contact Newsletter Events Book a Demo Securing the Digital Layer of Aviation CYVIATION is a cybersecurity company purpose-built for aviation - focused on making cyber risk visible, measurable, and manageable across aircraft and fleet operations. Our mission is to make aviation safer by making cyber risk visible continuously. Book a Demo What We Do Aviation is no longer just physical. It’s digital, connected, and exposed. CYVIATION builds the infrastructure that gives aviation organizations real visibility into cyber risk - across aircraft, systems, and operations. At the core is SkyRay - a platform that combines real-time threat intelligence with continuous compliance, enabling operators to move from reactive security to continuous awareness. Why CYVIATION Built for aviation Not adapted from generic cybersecurity - designed specifically for aircraft and aviation systems. Bridging the gap Aircraft evolve slowly. Cyber threats don’t. We close that gap with continuous visibility. From complexity to clarity We turn complex data into clear, actionable insight - so teams can act before incidents happen. Trusted Across the Aviation Ecosystem SkyRay is positioned at the center of the aviation ecosystem. Selected by Boeing Aviation Business Solutions as part of the SkyGuard cybersecurity offering. More Info Our Technology CYVIATION combines aircraft-level modeling with real-time intelligence: Digital twins for every aircraft Continuous, non-intrusive monitoring Integration with operational systems Real-time threat intelligence connected to fleet operations Our Approach Research-driven Built on deep aviation cybersecurity research.
